title: The Weight of Choice
text:
Existentialist philosophers argued that human beings are not defined by a fixed nature, but are instead shaped by the choices they make. This freedom, however, is not comfortable. Because no authority can settle every question on our behalf, each person must accept responsibility for the direction of their own life, and that responsibility can produce a sense of anxiety.

Sartre suggested that many people try to escape this anxiety through what he called bad faith, pretending that their decisions were dictated by circumstances, a job, or a social role. Authenticity, by contrast, requires acknowledging the freedom one has and accepting the consequences of using it. The authentic person does not deny choice, even when choice is difficult.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do existentialist philosophers say shapes human beings?
options: The decisions of a single authority

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what did Sartre call the attempt to escape anxiety by pretending decisions were dictated?
Why does the author describe freedom as 'not comfortable'?
options: Because freedom makes people responsible for their own choices without external guidance
Because freedom is only available to wealthy people
Because freedom requires people to live in isolation
Because freedom prevents people from making any decisions

questions.text: What can be inferred about the authentic person, according to the passage?
options: They attribute their choices to circumstances
They accept the consequences of their own freedom
They rely on social roles to guide their actions

vocabulary.definition: the power or right to make decisions and give orders
the duty to deal with something for which one is accountable
a feeling of worry or unease about something uncertain
the quality of being genuine and true to oneself

paragraph_translations: Varoluşçu filozoflar, insanların sabit bir doğaya göre değil, yaptıkları seçimlerle şekillendiğini savundu. Ancak bu özgürlük rahat değildir. Hiçbir otorite bizim adımıza her soruyu çözemediği için, herkes kendi hayatının yönünden sorumlu olmak zorundadır ve bu sorumluluk bir kaygı duygusu yaratabilir.

Sartre, birçok insanın bu kaygıdan kaçmaya çalıştığını ve buna 'kötü niyet' (bad faith) adını verdiğini öne sürdü. Bu durumda insanlar, kararlarının koşullar, bir iş ya da toplumsal bir rol tarafından belirlendiğini iddia eder. Özgünlük ise sahip olunan özgürlüğü kabul etmeyi ve onun sonuçlarına katlanmayı gerektirir. Özgün insan, seçimin zor olduğu durumlarda bile seçim olgusunu inkâr etmez.
